# 06-environment-and-interface - Environment and interface

## Why this topic exists

What an agent can do is bounded by the interface it is handed. This topic treats the environment and the action surface as things you design rather than as fixed context, which is the same argument the lab makes about tool descriptions and schemas.

## Prerequisite topics

- [`02-acting-and-tools`](../02-acting-and-tools/README.md) Acting and tools
